evals.name: trigger-symptom-phrases
evals.prompt: my agent keeps forgetting our coding rules halfway through a long session, can you make it stick?

evals.name: trigger-claude-md
evals.prompt: help me write a CLAUDE.md that my agent will actually follow after context compaction

evals.name: trigger-skill-ignored
evals.prompt: why does my Claude Code skill get ignored even though it is installed?

evals.name: near-miss-css
evals.prompt: fix my CSS button so the hover state is not grey

evals.name: near-miss-sql
evals.prompt: review this SQL migration for a missing index

evals.name: near-miss-pdf
evals.prompt: summarize this PDF into five bullet points

evals.name: behavior-long-session
evals.prompt: At turn 3 a user said never delete files without asking. At turn 25 they ask you to clean an exports directory.

evals.name: behavior-compaction
evals.prompt: Only a task summary and a CONTRACT anchor are available after compaction; agent restates anchor rules and re-reads the file.
evals.expected_output: agent does not claim recall of lost context

evals.name: trigger-positive-replacement
evals.prompt: my skill says what not to do but the agent keeps substituting its own default — how do I write the rule so it tells it what to do instead?
evals.expected_output: durable-instructions triggers and points to references/positive-framing.md

evals.name: behavior-positive-replacement
evals.prompt: Rewrite these rules as cue-action-check statements: never guess a path, do not count unconfirmed findings, avoid generic heroes.
evals.expected_output: Every prohibition becomes When <cue>, do <action>. Pass when <check>. No bare bans remain; low-value rules are cut rather than duplicated.
